name: Inference Fast Path for Volume Rendering
aliases: Inference fast path for volume rendering
definition: A compile-time specialization that skips the computation and storage of backward-only outputs (weight sum `outWs`, depth `outDepth`, total samples `outTotalSamples`) when gradients are not required, returning size-0 placeholder tensors instead.
summary: The Inference Fast Path is a compile-time specialization that skips backward-only output storage and computation when gradients are not required, reducing global-memory traffic and speeding up inference.
